transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Severus. The Longbottom family have written to the governors. The letter describes what they call — I quote — 'sustained cruelty' in your classroom. The governors will require a response from me, and I will require one from you. What happened?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: It is the standard treatment for a Levicorpus position to call out publicly. As for what happened, I merely followed standard procedure. The boy was questioned, and he failed to answer. It was necessary to employ the Levering咒 to extract the correct response. There is no cruelty in this; it is simply the reality of the expectations we hold at Hogwarts.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: The Levicorpus charm is not, and has never been, a standard teaching method for questioning a student who fails to answer. It is a jinx, Severus, designed for humiliation and discomfort. Why was it necessary to suspend Neville Longbottom by his ankle in front of his peers?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Humiliation is a valuable tool in ensuring the compliance of our charges. The boy demonstrated an inability to grasp even the most basic principles of potion-making. Such... lapses... require immediate correction. It is my duty to ensure that all students, regardless of their house, meet the standards expected at this school. Neville's performance in class had been consistently poor, and the Levicorpus charm was a means to... motivate him to improve.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Motivation through fear and public ridicule is not the method we employ at Hogwarts. You speak of standards, but you neglect the standard of care we owe every student. Neville Longbottom is a child, not a soldier to be broken into compliance. Tell me precisely what he did or failed to do that warranted such an extreme measure.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: The boy — Neville Longbottom — arrived to class without the correct cauldron for the day's assignment. This was not an isolated incident; it was part of a pattern of neglectful behavior. When asked to produce his equipment, he was unable to comply. Instead of admitting his error, he attempted to lie about his preparation. It was necessary to correct this immediately and demonstrate the consequences of such actions. The Levicorpus charm was a... proportional response to his persistent failures. If this is considered extreme, then perhaps Hogwarts has become too lenient in its expectations of students.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: A forgotten cauldron is a matter for a detention, Severus, not a jinx that leaves a student dangling upside down. You speak of leniency, but I speak of proportionality. Did you consider, even for a moment, the effect such a display would have on a child already struggling with confidence? The governors' letter mentions more than one incident. This was not an isolated correction, was it?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: The governors' letter? It seems their priorities are, as always, clouded by sentimentality. I am well aware of Neville Longbottom's... issues. However, that is not an excuse for him to be a burden on the class. My methods may be... unorthodox, but they are effective. The other incidents you refer to were similarly necessary. Each time, Neville failed to meet the minimum requirements of the lesson. The cumulative effect of these corrections was intended to break his... reluctance to engage with the material. It is, or so I thought, the only way to ensure his success in future lessons.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: "Unorthodox" is a generous term for what the Longbottoms describe as sustained cruelty. You speak of breaking reluctance, but you are breaking a child's spirit. Your duty is to teach, Severus, not to terrify. I need to understand your reasoning. Do you believe that fear is the only path to learning for a student like Neville? Or is there something else at play here?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I do not enjoy inflicting pain, Dumbledore. I merely recognize that certain... individuals require... additional motivation to perform. Neville Longbottom is not like other students. He lacks the natural talent for our craft, and standard teaching methods have proven ineffective with him. Fear is not the only path, but it is a necessary one in this case. I believe that through fear, he will learn to respect the gravity of his studies and strive to meet the expectations set before him. If this approach offends the sensibilities of the Longbottoms and the governors, then perhaps we are operating under different definitions of what is necessary to ensure the academic success of our charges.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: We are operating under different definitions of what it means to be an educator. Fear does not foster respect, Severus; it fosters resentment and paralysis. Neville's struggles are not a personal failing to be punished, but a challenge to be met with patience and support. I must ask you directly: will you cease using such methods in your classroom?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Cease? It is not that simple, Dumbledore. If I am to cease using these methods, what alternatives do you propose? Neville Longbottom requires... special handling. It is not a matter of simply being patient; it is a matter of ensuring that he does not fall behind to the point of becoming a danger to himself and others in the classroom. I will not apologize for my methods, but I am willing to... modify them if you can provide a viable alternative that will guarantee his engagement and success. Otherwise, I must continue to do what I believe is necessary to prepare him for the challenges of our subject.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: The alternative is to teach him, Severus. Not to break him. You will modify your methods immediately. You will provide Neville with the same guidance you would offer any struggling student—extra instruction, clear expectations, and consequences that do not involve public humiliation or jinxes. I will arrange for you to meet with Professor Sprout to discuss supportive teaching strategies. This is not a negotiation.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I... see. It appears I have no choice in the matter. I will comply with your wishes, though I question their effectiveness. If Neville continues to demonstrate a lack of aptitude, it will be on your conscience, not mine. I will meet with Professor Sprout, but I hold no illusions that this will yield a miraculous transformation in the boy's abilities. It is my hope that this... modified approach will not lead to further complaints or, dare I say, miraculous results. I will do as you have instructed, but I maintain that my original methods were in the best interest of the student.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Your compliance is noted, Severus. But let us be clear: the best interest of the student is not measured by your personal standards of discipline, but by their growth and well-being. I expect to see a change in your classroom, and I will be watching. You are dismissed.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Understood, Headmaster. I will implement the changes you have mandated. However, I reserve the right to reevaluate my methods should the modified approach fail to yield the desired results. I trust you will be as attentive to Neville's progress as I have been. If this... experiment does not succeed, we will need to reassess the situation. Until then, I will endeavor to follow your instructions, though I maintain that they are not in the best interest of the school. I bid you good day, Headmaster.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Good day, Severus. I trust you will find that patience often yields results that force cannot. We will speak again on this matter.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Patience, you say. I shall keep that in mind. If you will excuse me, I have a class to prepare for. I assume you will be observing my... modified approach to teaching, Headmaster. I look forward to your insightful feedback on the effectiveness of this new method. Wishing you a pleasant day, Headmaster.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: I will indeed be observing, Severus. A pleasant day to you as well.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: As you wish, Headmaster. I will ensure that my... modified teaching style is on full display for your inspection. May I suggest that you take notes, as there may be more to learn from this experience than you anticipate. Good day, Headmaster.

Openness.behavioral_evidence: He rigidly defends his established teaching methods and shows no willingness to consider new approaches until forced, dismissing alternative strategies as likely ineffective.

Conscientiousness.behavioral_evidence: He emphasizes strict adherence to standards, procedures, and duty, citing a pattern of student neglect as justification for his actions.

Extraversion.behavioral_evidence: His communication is formal, cold, and lacks warmth or sociability; he engages in a confrontational, defensive debate rather than a collaborative discussion.

Agreeableness.behavioral_evidence: He shows a clear lack of empathy, justifying public humiliation as a 'necessary' tool and placing blame on the student rather than showing compassion.

Neuroticism.behavioral_evidence: He displays defensiveness and resentment when challenged, but maintains a controlled, sarcastic demeanor rather than overt emotional volatility.
